name: Communications Support
summary: Backup and supplemental communications — nets, tactical channels, and Winlink email over radio when primary systems are degraded.

objectives: Stand up the communications plan and confirm every net and tactical channel works before operations begin.
Open and log a formal net; check in all stations and keep a current station roster.
Provide backup communications between the EOC, shelters, and field teams when primary systems are degraded.
Pass and log all formal traffic (ICS-213 messages) with times and originating and receiving stations.
Relay Winlink email over radio for stations without internet and confirm delivery.
Monitor for and relay any emergency or priority traffic immediately.
Keep a communications status board — which links are up, which are down, and the fallback for each.
data.safety_message: Operate only within your license privileges and the band plan. Keep clear of antennas while transmitting and watch RF exposure; keep coax and guy lines out of walkways and traffic. Manage battery and generator power — never run a generator indoors. Rotate operators to prevent fatigue on long nets.
